add_definitions(
    -D__WINESRC__
    -D__ROS_LONG64__
    -DUSE_NEW_WINE_REGISTER_RESOURCES)

spec2def(qedit.dll qedit.spec)

add_idl_reg_objects(qedit registry qedit_classes.idl)

# qedit.dll is C, and cargo compiles and links it:
# sdk/lib/rust/qedit-cargo (reactos-link, generated by tools/cargo_cell_gen.py).
# The C still compiled, in an OBJECT library whose compile the cargo link replays.
# How cmake compiled the target's sources, now on the OBJECT libraries.
# Generated inputs those compiles read, ordered before them.
add_library(qedit_shims OBJECT main.c mediadet.c nullrenderer.c samplegrabber.c timeline.c)
target_link_libraries(qedit_shims PRIVATE wine wine_dll_canunload strmbase strmiids uuid oldnames libole32 liboleaut32 libadvapi32 libuser32 libkernel32_vista libmsvcrt libkernel32 libntdll)
set_wine_module(qedit_shims)
add_dependencies(qedit_shims wineheaders)
set(QEDIT_REUSED
    ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/dll/directx/wine/qedit/qedit_classes_r.o)
add_cargo_module(qedit qedit-cargo qedit.dll
    KIND win32dll
    DESTINATION reactos/system32
    EXTRA_DEPENDS qedit_shims psdk qedit_r ${QEDIT_REUSED} dxsdk uuid_sources)
